Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Journey's End Keep
Cards.Text: Battle: Target your performing unbowed Personality to move home a target Personality with as many or fewer Followers attached; this will not be negated or delayed.

Cards.Name: Plains of the Maiden
Cards.Text: After you destroy a province or army in battle resolution as the Attacker: Gain Honor equal to the number of your Battle Maidens at the current battlefield.

Cards.Name: Law of Darkness Dojo
Cards.Text:
After another player loses Honor from your Battle action: He loses 1 Honor.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed, target an enemy Personality: Give him -4F. Bow him if he is dishonorable.

Cards.Name: Shamate Keep
Cards.Text:
Your dishonorable Paragons do not have a maximum Personal Honor of 0 from the rulebook.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and move home a target Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor. Gain 2 Honor if you do not control him.
